All six are verified unmutated: git status over docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/ reports only the new g19.v2/. The repository now holds thirty-one fixture directories, including fixtures/g20.v6/, created at D-327 by g20-fixture-corpus.v9 after the v2 list was written, and fixtures/g21.v10/ through g21.v12/.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The list is a curated adjacent-corpora declaration, not an exhaustiveness claim, and no clause asserts it covers every directory. Every named entry is true. The subject follows the lineage idiom faithfully by adding its own payload source fixtures/g19.v1/, exactly as g20-fixture-corpus.v9 added fixtures/g20.v2/. Both accepted G20 lists are equally non-exhaustive.
advisories.ifEverRepaired: A later successor may add docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g20.v6/ so the list keeps naming the current neighbouring corpora, or state plainly that the list is illustrative.

whatIsSound: The central authoring claim is exactly true on disk: forty-eight platform-indexed copies exist, in four directories named by the occupancy v2 tokens with slash replaced by dash, and every copy is byte-identical to its fixtures/g19.v1/ payload.
Every digest asserted anywhere in the document - 93 recordedInputs, 43 structural pairs, 12 payloads, 48 copies - recomputes from live bytes with zero disagreements.
The platform axis is quoted, not invented: ORDERED-EQUAL to occupancy v2, G10 occupancy v2 and G23 occupancy v2, with Windows excluded by a disposition the subject quotes rather than decides.
The authoring act is additive. The D-299 catalog's ids, classes, digests and all twelve expected strings are untouched; each mutation string gains one accurate sentence and nothing else.

The obligation position is honest. Nothing is closed, nothing is stolen, the twin-join requirement for closing OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING is stated correctly, and staleness is scoped to the authoring claim and conditioned on a future recording.

Custody is clean. D-330 is the sole last-heading claimant, the current-versus-historical split between leftover-join v6 and v5 is stated at every site, and both frozen predecessors are pinned, disclosed with true verdicts, and declined as current.

The three defect classes the sibling G20 lineage was rejected for - a mis-advanced landing token, an occupancy-as-naming-parent substitution, and a custody set omitting a frozen predecessor - are each absent here, and the subject carries failsIf tests for the first and third.
The speaker rename is complete and the version-token sweep was rerun for the new integer: zero ungoverned tokens, zero collisions with 3, zero deictic constructions.
